name: Belle-whisper-large-v3-zh
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.543 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2024-03-11. Caveat: Chinese-only; the card prints no multilingual numbers and no harness settings. Its own v2 predecessor scores better on four of five columns (2.549/3.746/8.503/14.598 vs 2.781/3.786/8.865/11.246), so the gain over whisper-large-v3 is not monotone along the Belle line.
